method: Anonymised run-1 stance summaries of politicians sampled at 30 quantiles per sub-topic axis (round 1), then up to 25 more near each fitted boundary (round 2), hand-labelled pro/con/neutral/na against the axis by Claude Opus 5.5. Cut points from a 3-zone ordinal fit on 1D x (con < neutral_from <= neutral < neutral_to <= pro). midpoint=(neutral_from+neutral_to)/2. ci90 = bootstrap of the midpoint. pct_* = share of all scaled politicians on each side.

status_values.calibrated: both sides present and ordered along x; show midpoint and band
status_values.one_sided_pro: almost everyone who addresses this sub-topic leans pro; there is no real con side on the plot
status_values.unclear: labels do not line up with x (or too few); do not show a midpoint

constitution.axis_reading: Core: support writing the SDF (or self-defence/国防軍) into the constitution vs opposing 9条 amendment/明記.

defencebudget.axis_reading: Core: support increasing defence spending/strengthening capability; opposing only the tax-financing while backing the increase counted as pro; supporting need but criticising scale/priority roughly equally = neutral.

collectiveselfdefence.axis_reading: Core: support exercising (incl. limited) collective self-defence / 平和安全法制. Pro statement oddly adds 憲法に明記; ignored. Opposing overseas dispatch alone not counted.

foodsecurity.axis_reading: Ill-defined con: con statement is not opposition to food security (it is crowding-out worry / private role). Pro = treats food self-sufficiency as a security priority; con essentially unused; most members na.

workemployment.sub_topic_jp: 少子化対策としての就業と雇用環境改善
workemployment.axis_reading: Ill-defined: pro and con are compatible (con only says employment alone is insufficient). Read as: pro = treats stable employment/wages/work-environment as a key fertility lever; con = doubts economic/employment causes of low fertility (only 3553).

educationcost.sub_topic_jp: 少子化対策としての教育負担軽減
educationcost.axis_reading: Core: support free/cheaper education (preschool to university) as child policy. Con = cautious/opposes free education; members who say waitlist (待機児童) must come before preschool 無償化 were labelled con (priority/quality objection, not cost), neutral if they also back other free education.

budgetpriority.sub_topic_jp: 防衛費と少子化対策予算の優先順位
budgetpriority.axis_reading: Core: prioritise childcare/child budget over defence spending (pro) vs defence is essential first (con). Members worried about burden of both defence and childcare without choosing = na/neutral. No con found.

parentalleave.sub_topic_jp: 育児休業の拡充と参加促進
parentalleave.axis_reading: Core: expand/promote parental leave for both parents (pro) vs concern about burden on firms (con). Members critical only of design or skeptical of fertility effect but backing uptake still pro; no con found.

restart.sub_topic_jp: 原発の再稼働について
restart.axis_reading: pro = supports restarting reactors that pass regulatory review (incl. conditional); con = opposes/strongly resists restarts

newbuildandextendlifetime.sub_topic_jp: 原発の新設や運転期間延長について
newbuildandextendlifetime.axis_reading: pro = supports new builds/replacement or operating-life extension; con = opposes them (40-year rule, no new build)

export.axis_reading: pro = supports exporting nuclear plants/technology; con = opposes export

abolishandrenewable.sub_topic_jp: 原発廃止と再生可能エネルギーの導入
abolishandrenewable.axis_reading: pro = phase out nuclear and shift to renewables; con = keep nuclear in the mix alongside renewables (gov't 'reduce dependence but use as baseload' line coded con or neutral depending on emphasis)

fukushimasupport.sub_topic_jp: 福島第一原発事故後の被害者支援と賠償問題
fukushimasupport.axis_reading: ILL-DEFINED: pro and con statements are not opposites (con = nationwide burden-sharing rather than only local govts/firms). Read as pro = pushes for fuller victim support/compensation and state responsibility; con = favours spreading costs to all consumers/limiting support; most people pro or na

fossilfuelreduction.sub_topic_jp: 化石燃料依存からの脱却と再生可能エネルギーの推進について
fossilfuelreduction.axis_reading: pro = rapid shift off fossil fuels / maximise renewables, coal phase-out; con = fossil reduction must be gradual, keep thermal/coal for stable supply; 'all options incl. LNG/thermal transition' coded neutral

nuclearenergyuse.sub_topic_jp: 原子力発電の利用の是非について
nuclearenergyuse.axis_reading: pro = use/restart nuclear for decarbonisation; con = reduce/oppose nuclear dependence in favour of renewables

carbonneutralgoal.sub_topic_jp: カーボンニュートラル目標の実現に向けた具体策について
carbonneutralgoal.axis_reading: SOMEWHAT ILL-DEFINED: both sides accept CN; read as pro = accelerate/ambitious CN via investment, tech, renewables (incl. H2/ammonia); con = prioritise economic realism, avoid rapid transition, stress burden/costs. Left critics of H2/ammonia who want faster cuts coded pro

localvsnatinalrole.sub_topic_jp: 気候変動対策における地方と国の役割について
localvsnatinalrole.axis_reading: pro = local governments/communities lead (local production-consumption of renewables) with national financial support; con = national-led uniform policy, local role complementary; almost nobody argues the con side, so most are pro or na

smallbusinesssupport.sub_topic_jp: 中小企業支援の強化について
smallbusinesssupport.axis_reading: pro = strengthen SME support (funding, price pass-through, subsidies); con = selective/limited support, avoid propping up uncompetitive firms or excessive intervention.

consumptiontaxreduction.sub_topic_jp: 消費税の減税について
consumptiontaxreduction.axis_reading: pro = cut/abolish consumption tax or clearly oppose hikes on regressivity/demand grounds; con = support raising/maintaining it as social-security revenue; conditional/mixed = neutral.

foreignworkers.sub_topic_jp: 外国人労働者の受け入れについて
foreignworkers.axis_reading: pro = expand acceptance of foreign workers; con = cautious/restrictive. Rarely addressed in economy summaries.

monetarypolicyreview.sub_topic_jp: 金融緩和政策の見直し
monetarypolicyreview.axis_reading: Inverted framing: pro = review/normalise/exit easing (side effects, weak yen); con = maintain or strengthen easing / avoid hasty rate hikes.

governmentintervention.sub_topic_jp: 政府の積極的な経済介入について
governmentintervention.axis_reading: pro = active state role (fiscal stimulus, industrial policy, public works, labour/market regulation); con = deregulation, structural reform, private-led, fiscal restraint over stimulus.

taxreductionmeasures.sub_topic_jp: 物価高対策の財政的手段としての減税
taxreductionmeasures.axis_reading: pro = supports tax cuts (esp. consumption-tax cut) as a cost-of-living measure; con = opposes/cautious on tax cuts for fiscal reasons; opposing consumption-tax cut while backing a one-off income-tax cut = neutral

wageincreasepromotion.sub_topic_jp: 賃上げの促進とその実施環境
wageincreasepromotion.axis_reading: pro = wants wage rises actively promoted/supported by policy; con = caution because of the burden on firms; doubts about specific tools (wage tax credit) alone are not con

consumptionhaxincrease.sub_topic_jp: 消費税の引き上げとその影響
consumptionhaxincrease.axis_reading: pro = defends/raises consumption tax as stable social-security revenue; con = opposes consumption-tax increases or wants it cut

smallbusinesssupport.sub_topic_jp: 中小企業支援の重要性
smallbusinesssupport.axis_reading: ILL-DEFINED: con statement still calls for (better) SME support; read as pro = calls for SME support, con = skeptical of/opposes SME support; criticism of big-firm favouritism counted as pro

sustainability.sub_topic_jp: 社会保障制度の持続可能性の確保
sustainability.axis_reading: ILL-DEFINED: both statements favour reform and sparing the working generation; read as pro = prioritise sustainability reforms (restraint/efficiency/burden restructuring), con = resist cuts/burden-raising reviews

benefitburdenbalance.sub_topic_jp: 受益と負担のバランス
benefitburdenbalance.axis_reading: pro = clear benefit-burden link and fair burden-sharing across/within generations (ability-based, elderly pay their share); con = oppose burden increases on patients/elderly/low-income as unfair

consumptionhaxforsocialsecurity.sub_topic_jp: 消費税の社会保障への利用
consumptionhaxforsocialsecurity.axis_reading: pro = support consumption tax (and its hikes) as social security funding; con = oppose hikes / call it unsuitable or want cuts

longtermdareinsurancereform.axis_reading: ILL-DEFINED: pro says 'enhance LTC', con says 'reforms may lower quality' (opposition wants both); read as pro = supportive of LTC insurance reform/review direction, con = critical of reforms as cutting benefits/raising user burden

younggenerationburden.sub_topic_jp: 若い世代への負担軽減
younggenerationburden.axis_reading: ILL-DEFINED: both statements favour relieving young/working generation; read as pro = prioritise relieving young/working-generation burden (shift from elderly-centred system), con = resist shifting burden onto elderly / reject elderly-vs-young framing

basicpensionsubsidy.sub_topic_jp: 基礎年金の国庫負担割合の引き上げ
basicpensionsubsidy.axis_reading: pro = supports raising/securing the state (tax) share of the basic pension (1/3 -> 1/2 or more), even if objecting to a particular tax source; con = doubts/opposes raising it on fiscal grounds

basicpensionbottomup.axis_reading: pro = wants basic pension level raised/protected (stop macro slide on basic pension, minimum-guarantee top-ups); con = holds current level adequate or opposes top-up schemes (e.g. tax-funded minimum pension) for fiscal reasons

employeespensionissue.sub_topic_jp: 厚生年金の未加入者問題
employeespensionissue.axis_reading: pro = extend employees' pension coverage (part-timers, unenrolled firms); con = resists expansion (burden on firms etc.); support conditional mainly on SME burden = neutral

pensionsystemunification.axis_reading: pro = supports unifying schemes (KNK/kyosai, or all incl. national pension); con = cautious/opposed to unification

pensionreformtransparency.axis_reading: ILL-DEFINED: both statements call for transparency; read as pro = constructive call for clearer explanation/information to restore trust, con = accuses reform process of being opaque/untrustworthy (misleading figures, forced votes, hidden decisions)

selectivefamilyseparate.sub_topic_jp: 選択的夫婦別姓制度の導入
selectivefamilyseparate.axis_reading: pro = supports introducing selective separate surnames; con = opposes/cautious

oldnameuse.sub_topic_jp: 旧姓の使用と通称使用の拡大
oldnameuse.axis_reading: pro = favours expanding/legalising maiden-name (通称/婚前氏) use as the remedy; con = says old-name use is insufficient/opposes legalising it (both pro-別姓 'insufficient' and anti-legal-basis views)

governmentstance.axis_reading: ill-defined (both statements criticise govt); read pro = criticises govt/LDP inaction and demands it act toward 別姓, con = defends cautious govt stance / wait for public consensus

introduction.sub_topic_jp: オンライン投票の導入
introduction.axis_reading: pro = supports introducing online/internet voting; con = cautious/opposed (persons 1605 and 4540 talk about online betting for horse racing (ネット投票), not elections -> all na)

electoralsystemimpact.axis_reading: pro = sees online voting as positive reform (participation, overseas voters, resilience); con = sees it as threatening the foundations/fairness of the electoral system

technicalchallenges.axis_reading: vague; pro = technical issues (security, ID) solvable and benefits (speed, cost) outweigh; con = security/ID risks too high for now

transparencyfairness.sub_topic_jp: 透明性と公正性の確保
transparencyfairness.axis_reading: vague; pro = fairness/transparency can be secured (or online voting improves it); con = absence of 立会人/管理者 endangers fairness, needs caution

gradualintroduction.axis_reading: pro = supports staged rollout (overseas voters first, pilots, e-voting first); con = opposes overseas-first/stepwise path or using it as a stepping stone

popularizationconcerns.sub_topic_jp: マイナンバー制度の普及と懸念
popularizationconcerns.axis_reading: pro = supports spreading/using the My Number system and card; con = primarily concerned/opposed (privacy, forced uptake)

onlinequalificationconfirmation.sub_topic_jp: オンライン資格確認の導入
onlinequalificationconfirmation.axis_reading: pro = supports card-based online insurance qualification checks in clinics; con = opposes / stresses harm to clinics, elderly, disabled

privacysecurity.sub_topic_jp: 個人情報保護とマイナンバーのセキュリティ
privacysecurity.axis_reading: pro = system is/can be made safe, concerns are misunderstanding or fixable human error; con = leaks/trust loss show serious unresolved privacy risk

mandatory.sub_topic_jp: マイナンバー制度の義務化
mandatory.axis_reading: pro = supports mandatory card acquisition or mandatory My Number linkage (e.g. bank accounts); con = insists acquisition stay voluntary / opposes de facto compulsion

healthinsuranceintegration.sub_topic_jp: 健康保険証との一体化について
healthinsuranceintegration.axis_reading: pro = supports merging insurance card into My Number card / abolishing paper card; con = opposes abolition or wants paper card kept

digitalization.sub_topic_jp: マイナンバー制度のデジタル化
digitalization.axis_reading: pro = My Number-driven digitalisation is key to efficiency; con = card-centred/formal digitalisation insufficient, risks leaving people behind

samesexmarriage.sub_topic_jp: 同性婚を法制化すべきか
samesexmarriage.axis_reading: pro = supports legalising same-sex marriage; con = opposes or 'extremely cautious' govt line amounting to not introducing

antidiscriminationlaw.sub_topic_jp: LGBT差別禁止法／理解増進法の制定
antidiscriminationlaw.axis_reading: pro = supports enacting an LGBT anti-discrimination or understanding-promotion law (incl. wanting a stronger one); con = opposes new law / existing law suffices

constitution24.sub_topic_jp: 憲法24条の解釈（同性婚が想定されているか）
constitution24.axis_reading: pro = Art.24 does not bar same-sex marriage (13/14 support it); con = Art.24 presumes opposite-sex marriage ('想定していない')

publicunderstanding.sub_topic_jp: 国民的理解・家族観が整うまで法整備を待つべきか
publicunderstanding.axis_reading: pro = legislate now, don't wait for consensus; con = wait for national consensus/understanding, watch trends

internationalimpact.sub_topic_jp: 国際的評価・経済への影響
internationalimpact.axis_reading: pro = cites G7/international standards or economic costs as reason to act; con = domestic matter, no need to follow foreign pressure

transgendertoilet.sub_topic_jp: トランスジェンダーのトイレ・更衣室利用
transgendertoilet.axis_reading: pro = gender-identity-based facility use fine / safety fears unfounded; con = body-based separation or safety concerns take priority

religiousinfluence.sub_topic_jp: 宗教団体（旧統一教会など）と政策決定への影響
religiousinfluence.axis_reading: pro = religious groups (ex-Unification Church) distorted policy, must be cut off; con = influence overstated

selectivesurname.sub_topic_jp: 選択的夫婦別姓の導入
selectivesurname.axis_reading: pro = supports introducing selective separate surnames; con = opposes

participationrights.sub_topic_jp: 法案作成における当事者参加・合理的配慮の明記
participationrights.axis_reading: pro = law should mandate LGBT stakeholder participation / reasonable accommodation; con = against detailed mandates

foreignspouse.sub_topic_jp: 外国人同性配偶者への在留資格
foreignspouse.axis_reading: pro = grant residence status to foreign same-sex spouses; con = not uniformly, case-by-case suffices
